title: The voice update
items: About 1,570 missing voice lines are now recorded: the Neon Ward calamities and road enemies, Wukong and Gogo's full kits, and the new match-ups, each in the character's own voice
Every fighter has two new opening lines. Match-up lines now play about half the time; otherwise each side picks an opener and never repeats the one from the last fight
Subtitles now match what's spoken. Fixed rivals showing their old quote under a different intro line, card lines showing only the card name, and lines with no subtitle at all

Script pass: Kuro is no longer talked about like a dog, Sol is addressed as a woman, Hana's quote and several confusing or contradicting lines were rewritten and re-recorded, and reply lines no longer play before the line they answer
Fixed: pressing Back on fighter select after a fight now goes to the main menu instead of the finished fight
Desktop: the game window now remembers its size and position (needs the new installer)

title: Element finishers and new Kaede art
items: New finisher bursts for every element: fire, ice, shadow, lightning, steel, poison, blood, water, life, sound, wind and psychic, plus a white-gold burst for plain technique moves
Physical finishers burst in the card's element; Spirit Finishers burst in the fighter's element; enemy finishers play mirrored from their side
Free roam: a new 'New art' option under Kaede sprite in the pause menu gives Kaede a fully animated breathing idle (running and attacks keep the current frames for now)

title: Lit stages and win badges
items: Fixed: some rounds started with the arena grey and dim. A fight that ended during a counter window or a freeze effect left that filter on for the next round
Removed the coloured box glow behind the fighter whose turn it is (the red arrow still marks the turn; awakening glow is unchanged)
Win badges: every fighter you've won a run with shows a gold trophy on their tile, with a count after two or more wins

HD-2D stages: the camera now fits itself so both fighters stand on the stage's clearing at every screen size, with the set framed between them (lantern string on the road, torii and shrine hall at the shrine, the red bridge between two banks)
HD-2D stages: fighters pick up the stage's light (cool moonlight, warm lantern glow, drifting bamboo shade) and the moon casts their shadows onto the ground

title: Phones, tablets and a 3D test stage
items: New menu button on phones and tablets: Settings, Save, How to play, Run status, Fast animations and Rival turn ×2 are one tap away on every screen, no Escape key needed
Phones and tablets play in landscape (the Android app locks it; in a browser you're asked to turn the device)
Bigger tap targets on phones and tablets: buttons, chips, settings controls and the fighter roster meet touch-size guidelines
Dialogs like Settings scale up and scroll on small screens so the text is readable
Fighter select on phones: the roster is a two-row strip you swipe sideways
The Settings coin in the corner bar is now a gear
New test setting (Gameplay): HD-2D stages. Fights play in front of a 3D Moonlit Bamboo Road set that drifts, shakes on hits and sweeps on ultimates

title: Neon Ward polish
items: The Bosozoku Horn Kid now has his voice, and the Irezumi Dragon roars
The biker gang and the Pachinko Tsukumogami were redrawn: their rising-sun patterns are now flames, dragon crests and lucky sevens
Horde waves: a foe knocked out while launched no longer leaves its air pose over the next foe
The end-of-run Pass the torch screen now scrolls, so you can pick any technique from a big deck

title: Neon Ward
items: New region south of the festival: the Neon Ward, a rain-soaked Neo-Tokyo district that opens after the Semifinal. Reach it down the canal from Sake Alley, or by fast travel
Six new enemies: the Bosozoku biker gang (always rides as a crew of three), the Ghost Taxi, the Pachinko Tsukumogami and the Host Club Kitsune

Three bosses: Mama-san of the Snack Bar, the Oyabun with his living irezumi dragon, and the Neon Jorogumo at the top of the Web Tower. The Oyabun's teahouse opens once Mama-san vouches for you; the tower opens after the Oyabun, or by Ghost Train
Jo's high-stakes table at the Lucky Star Casino, mentor scenes on the Inari rooftop, a 24-hour konbini and an irezumi parlor that inks permanent buffs
New minigames: a UFO crane game and pachinko. Region events: Blackout, Neon Matsuri and Rent Day
Three free-roam stages (Neon Arcade Street, Shuto Expressway, Neon Rooftops), eight new fight backdrops and match-up lines between the new enemies and the whole cast

title: Stability & Quality of Life
items: Fixed: a fight could get stuck on screen after a K.O. that happened at the very start (bleed at low HP, or an Ambush that finished a weak foe)
New rule: no one can be knocked out by status effects or start-of-fight effects on turn 1. They hold at 1 HP
Fixed: Continue could reload a road or free-roam fight you had already finished
Fixed: choosing "Never mind" on a card pick (boss spoils, gifts, elite spoils, the vault) no longer hands you a card at random. You take nothing
Fixed: Copy result on the Daily challenge no longer claims it copied when the clipboard is blocked
New setting (Gameplay): Super Art cinematics, Full, First time per run, or Off
Fast animations now stays on between sessions
Full health now fills the whole health bar

Less flicker: impact frames, counters, crits and hit flashes no longer snap the whole screen to white or black for a frame, cut-ins fade out instead of popping, and menus no longer use a background blur that could flicker on high-resolution screens
Super Art cinematics fill the whole screen on every screen shape, and every fighter finishes their closing line before the fight returns
Cinematics fade smoothly back into the fight instead of cutting out
Every enemy and wanderer in free roam breathes with the same idle motion as the fighters
Fixed: some free-roam enemies could be invisible (only their shadow showed) until their art finished loading
Skip a Super Art cinematic with Space, Enter or Esc as well as a tap
Cinematics can no longer hang: they close themselves if anything goes wrong

title: Calamities, Size Chart & Fighter Bios
items: New Calamity: The Landlord, a grumpy building super. Rent is due every 3 turns; at half HP he starts Renovation and every wall comes down
New Calamity: Tama the Cat. She naps and can't be hurt. Wake her and she knocks cards out of your hand, then hits 3 AM Zoomies
Seven more Calamities: Golf Dad, the Exam Proctor, Rush Hour, the Weatherman, Lunch Lady Oba, the Customer Service Hold Line, plus two serious ones from Stage 3: the Unborn Sun and the Ninth Founder
Every character now shows at true relative size, in fights, supers and the codex. Kuzuryu looms, the Mochi Twins are snack-sized
Codex: new Fighters and Mentors tabs. Every bio now lists height, likes and dislikes
The Mochi Twins are now Mochi and Matcha. They call each other by name, and scream it when the other falls
All enemies and Nyx got flinch, launch and knockdown animations
New Calamity relics, keepsakes, and match-up lines with the whole cast

title: New Fight Stages
items: Mistveil Marsh: four new fight stages: Stilt Village, Whispering Bamboo, Mossy Graveyard and the Broken Waterwheel
Crimson Coast: three new fight stages: Cliffside Dojo, Lighthouse Point and the Whaling Village
Fights now take place on the stage for wherever you are on the map, and never on top of the map itself

title: New Ultimates
items: Cinematic Ultimate Arts for Kaede (Dynamic Blossom), Suzu (Raiko Rush), Rasetsu (Mountain Splitter) and Nia (Teacup Voyage), each with its own banner, voice lines and sound design
New Nia card, Storybook Summon: pulls a Rabbit Knight, Paper Dragon, Teacup Serpent or Big Bad Wolf out of her book to fight beside her
Her creature strikes for 2 plus its own status each time she plays a card; rivals can attack it, and recasting swaps in a new one

title: Cinematic Super Arts
items: 30 fighters' Lv1 Super Arts now play as full-screen animated cinematics with their own sound design and voice lines
New this update: Kuro, Lyra, Uzume, Shura, Rasetsu, Maya, Tetsu, the Duelist, Gogo, Ito and Wukong
Tap anywhere to skip a cinematic

title: The Launcher
items: Last Seed now opens into its own launcher with news, patch notes and one-click updates
Updates download only the files that changed, and resume if you close the launcher mid-download
Launcher settings: auto-update, repair game files, and hide/minimize/close while you play

title: PC Settings
items: New Settings menu (Esc): window mode, resolutions from 1280×720 to 4K and ultrawide, monitor picker
Frame rate: match your screen (120/144 Hz and up), cap at 30–240, or unlimited; optional FPS counter
Graphics, Audio, Gameplay and Controls tabs, plus Quit to desktop

title: 16 New Enemies
items: Horde: Lantern Bomber, Rat in a Coat, Rokurokubi Lookout, Door-Guard Oni, Empty Yoroi, Taiko War-Drummer
Road: Speed-Ramen Courier, Sumo Baby, Livestreamer, Obaa-chan, Kitsune Fortune Teller, Unbreakable Daruma, Street-Stall Chef, Karaoke Yurei
Minibosses: Kintaro Bear and the Lantern Bomber King
Every new enemy flinches, gets launched, tumbles and gets knocked down; the rats fall out of the coat when you hit it
